integrity: The proof is self-contained given the stated multiplication. Finite-field enumerations are auxiliary checks, not substitutes for its all-field argument. The defining Example 4.6 is credited to Saha and Towers; no authorship or priority claim for it.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to abelian subalgebras of one specified seven-dimensional algebra. Full text of one plausible earlier Lie centralizer-count paper was unavailable; exact novelty is subject to that residual risk. No assertions about all subalgebras, automorphism orbits or other CB algebras.
title: Projective classification and complete abelian-subalgebra counts in the minimal class-three CB algebra
